what: Planned EXIT fallback is registered too late and may lose the original rc
scenario_or_breakage: Current early exits before the existing trap registration would still produce no TALLY_PLAN_REVIEW_STATUS, and checking $? at the end of cleanup after rm -rf can see rm's rc instead of the script failure
suggested_fix: Initialize the guard and WORKDIR early, register the trap before the first possible non-zero exit, capture local rc=$? as the first cleanup statement, emit tally-error based on that rc, then return rc

what: Per-voter KV helper shape conflicts with byte-identical stdout order
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed helper emits four grouped KVs per voter, but today's block interleaves VOTER_2_PATH, VOTER_3_PATH, VOTER_PATHS_FILE, then tool/status/parse-rate fields; a literal helper call sequence can silently reorder the public KV stream
suggested_fix: Define the helper to emit the exact existing block order, or document the helper as lower-level primitives and keep VOTER_PATHS_FILE placement unchanged
